subject: Least-privilege verification & SCIM sync sample
messages:
From: Alice Martin <security@curiepharma.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: it-admin@curiepharma.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Least-privilege verification & SCIM sync sample

Hi Ben,

Thanks for agreeing to help Curie Pharma with our CAIQ/SIG follow-up. Our auditor has asked for a short package to validate least-privilege practices for user provisioning before the Friday review:

- A 24–72 hour sample of SCIM delta sync output (anonymized) showing user creates, updates, and group assignments
- A role-to-permission matrix (CSV) for application-level roles we can map to our own RBAC model
- Evidence that orphaned access is removed within your configured offboarding window (logs or a short runbook)
- Example SAML assertion for a web SSO login including attributes you send (name, email, groups)

If you can send a compact bundle and a one-page workback timeline we can attach it to the SIG packet.

We realize some artifacts are sensitive — a redacted sample or a hashed identifier is fine. Can you also confirm which engineering role at Redwood will be our point-of-contact for any follow-ups?

Best,
Alice Martin
Principal Security Engineer
Curie Pharma
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Martin <security@curiepharma.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Least-privilege verification & SCIM sync sample

Alice —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver a redacted SCIM delta sample and the role matrix. Proposed plan (high level):

1) I will attach a redacted SCIM sample and the role-to-permission CSV for your review (see SCIM-mapping-draft.csv).
2) Hannah (copied internally) will pull a short RBAC activation log sample and confirm offboarding retention windows.
3) Jonas will capture a SAML assertion example and a short note on attribute mappings.
4) I will produce a one-page workback plan and timeline for the auditor.

Tentative delivery: 2027-05-12 COB for the initial bundle; final artifacts by 2027-05-21 after internal QA. If you need anything sooner, tell me which artifact to prioritize and we will escalate.

Attachments: SCIM-mapping-draft.csv, least-privilege-workback-plan.docx

Point of contact for technical follow-ups: ben_carter@redwood.ai (me).

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Least-privilege verification & SCIM sync sample

Ben / Jonas — forwarding Curie's request. Notes:

- Jonas, please extract a 72-hour RBAC activation log (only metadata, redact PII) showing role grants and revocations. They specifically want evidence of deprovisioning within our policy window.
- Include a short blurb on our SCIM conflict resolution behavior (most recent write wins + source-of-truth tag).
- Add a sample SAML assertion (with groups claim) and note the attribute names we emit.

Jonas, can you confirm ETA for the log extract and attach rb ac-activation-sample.log?

Thanks — Hannah
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Alice Martin <security@curiepharma.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Least-privilege verification & SCIM sync sample

Hi all —

I pulled the requested artifacts and performed a small redaction pass:

- scim-sync-sample-20270501.json (attached) — contains create/update/delete deltas for 72 hours, identifiers hashed with SHA256 per our redaction guidance
- rbac-activation-sample.log (attached) — shows role grant and revoke events with timestamps; I trimmed call traces and left only event type, role, actor-id (hashed), and timestamp
- SAML assertion example: included as the first entry in the JSON file (attribute set: uid, email, displayName, groups)

Notes on offboarding: our automated deprovisioning job runs within 48 hours of a directory event for enterprise-managed users; we retain activation logs for 90 days as a compliance dataset. The runbook excerpt is on the shared drive (link below).

Delivery ETA: sending artifacts now; please review and tell me if we need a different hash algorithm or a tighter window.

---
Attachment list: scim-sync-sample-20270501.json, rbac-activation-sample.log
Shared drive: https://drive.redwood.local/shared/curie-pharma/least-privilege-pack

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Martin <security@curiepharma.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: it-admin@curiepharma.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Least-privilege verification & SCIM sync sample

Ben / Jonas —

Received the bundle, thank you. The redacted SCIM delta and the RBAC activation log look good for our auditor; the hashed identifiers are acceptable. A couple of quick clarifications so we can close the item in the SIG: 

- Please confirm the exact offboarding SLA you commit to in writing (Jonas mentioned 48 hours automated deprovisioning; can you state this as an SLA for enterprise-managed directory events?)
- We need a one-line confirmation that your SAML assertions include a groups claim and that group names map directly to application roles, not temporary session state.

If you can reply with those two confirmations and the link to the one-page workback, we will attach the response to the CAIQ and mark the control as satisfied.

Best,
Alice Martin
Principal Security Engineer
Curie Pharma
